photo_dates: Street View almost all Sep 2014 (W10 Aug 2015, c8 Jul 2019); Earth mesh 2024; ortho Aug 2023. No 2023-2025 Street View exists around C2, so small objects (bins, bikes, roof-terrace furniture) may have changed.

brick.where: all brick walls: a uniform warm tan-brown modular brick, stretcher bond. Sampled sunlit on the NE/E block #c5a683-#cbad8f (sv_c10), NE shade #a28771 (sv_W11); the NW and SW faces in shade read mid-brown in Street View. brick_brown (6 Lab) is the compromise; in hard sun it reads as brick_buff

concrete.where: the bush-hammered concrete stair/shaft towers on W2, the ground-floor base walls, the corner piers and the NE annex (W11 base sampled #b2aea4 in shade, panel_grey/concrete_raw 1-2 Lab)

concrete_white.where: the shaft towers and the walls behind them on the SE side (W8/W9) read white in sun (sv_W9_y #f1f1ef); probably painted or just very light concrete in full sun. Guess: use panel_white there; if it looks wrong next to the W2 towers, use concrete everywhere

coping.where: green patinated copper flashing on every parapet and on the NE annex. The 2023 ortho outlines every roof edge in pale teal; W11 annex coping visibly verdigris in sv_W11. glass_teal is 10-11 Lab away: OK

frame.where: black or dark bronze window and door frames and mullions

bridge_ribbed.where: horizontally ribbed beige metal cladding bands on the DC bridge

bridge_panel.where: smooth yellow-tan metal panel band on the DC bridge between the ribbed bands (10.6 Lab to dirt; a palette swatch with a better name would be welcome)

bridge_fascia.where: dark navy or charcoal fascia band under the DC bridge

bridge_red.where: red painted steel posts, crossbeams and tie rods holding the DC bridge. Sunlit raw #6c1f20 is under-exposed; the hue is a saturated signal red, 13.8 Lab from steel_red

tank_white.where: liquid-gas storage tank and the finned aluminium vaporiser at W9

loading_door.where: grey sectional overhead doors at the W8 dock

plaza_brick.where: red-brick pavers of the fountain square SW of W6 (ortho; Street View is under-exposed)

common.storeys: 3 storeys plus a 4th-level mechanical penthouse. Main parapet 12.5 m (lidar 11.9-12.8); the SW low block (W5/W6) is 8.6 m; the penthouse is 17.8 m; the concrete shaft towers are 16.2-16.8 m.
common.ribbon_rule: every opening above the ground is a horizontal ribbon window, cut straight into the brick with no sill or head trim: black frames, dark glass, mullions about 0.9-1.2 m apart. L2 ribbons are about 1.2-1.6 m tall (sill about 5.2 m), L3 ribbons about 1.4 m (sill about 9.2 m). Each brick section has one or two ribbons per floor, and ribbons on L2 and L3 line up vertically
common.ground_rule: the ground floor is a light concrete base or recessed glazing under the brick, which oversails it by about 0.3-1.5 m. Concrete piers stand at the corners where the ground is cut away (NW corner entrance, E corner entrance)
common.towers: bush-hammered concrete shaft/stair towers with horizontal form joints about 1.2 m apart and visible tie holes. They run full height and rise about 4 m above the brick parapet, 2 on W2 and 2 on W9, and give the NW and SE fronts a tower-brick-tower rhythm

geometry_notes: W5/W6 (and W7 s 0-6, W4 s 2.5-7.6) are a two-storey 8.6 m low block. The 12.7 m main block's SW face stands about 6-8 m behind it as a setback storey with a railing at its foot; the lidar tiers should show this, so check it's not flattened to 12.7 m.

Penthouse: one central mechanical box, 17.8 m, about 32 x 13 m, sitting about 8 m in from W9 and parallel to it (ortho px 540-1060 x 440-810). Light grey or white concrete; Earth shows a large louvred panel on its NW and NE faces and a few small strip windows on the NW face.

Four concrete shaft towers rise to 16.2-16.8 m: W2 s 6-11.5 and s 24.5-32, W9 s 0-6 and s 13-19, each about 1-2 m deep into the plan. They read as separate chimneys above the 12.5 m roof (Earth W2_whole).
W11 concrete annex (2.8 m tall, about 2.5 m deep) projects outside the traced wall line along its whole length; walls.json follows the brick.
W8 dock block (4.2 m) is the traced line; the brick main wall is about 4 m behind it.
ESC link: lidar about 10.5 m, between W7 s about 13-23 and ESC's north wall, about 5 m long N-S; its ground floor is an open covered passage.
Ground floors are recessed under the brick at the NW corner entrance (W2 s 39.8-43.1 + W3 s 0-3), the NE entrance (W2 s 1.2-6) and the E entrance (W10).

Soffit about 4.7 m, top about 9.7 m, about 4 m wide. Carried on red steel H-frames (two posts plus a crossbeam at about 4.5 m) on round concrete footings, with red diagonal tie rods to the bridge side (sv_W0, sv_c13, sv_c15)
